sourceDefinitions.note: Disabled: the EIA international dataset does not identify a Qatar LNG volume-at-risk series. Dry natural gas production/export baselines are kept as separate annual context and are not converted into LNG or current cargo volumes.

sourceDefinitions.title: PortWatch route and chokepoint context
sourceDefinitions.note: Uses the official Daily_Chokepoints_Data layer (PortWatch dataset item 3da2b9ca97684916b75c4013f95d18ab), portid chokepoint6. n_total is an AIS-based all-vessel daily transit count; it is not an LNG-only count or a derived route-pressure score. If unavailable, do not carry forward the differently scoped Kpler commodity-vessel series.

sourceDefinitions.title: Dutch TTF chart API
sourceDefinitions.note: Retired from automatic refresh on 2026-10-15. Previously reviewed TTF observations remain dated historical records; do not promote new values from this connector.

sourceDefinitions.title: Reuters QatarEnergy force-majeure update
sourceDefinitions.note: Manual reviewed source. Automation carries the dated Reuters report and does not infer total Qatar output loss from selected buyer notices.

sourceDefinitions.title: EIA Qatar dry natural gas production baseline
sourceDefinitions.note: Annual EIA dry natural gas production for Qatar. This is structural gas context, not LNG output, terminal throughput, or current cargo availability.

sourceDefinitions.title: EIA Qatar dry natural gas export baseline
sourceDefinitions.note: Annual EIA dry natural gas exports for Qatar, including both LNG and pipeline gas. This is structural export context, not LNG-only export or current cargo movement.

sourceDefinitions.title: GEM Ras Laffan LNG terminal capacity
sourceDefinitions.note: GEM asset metadata identifies public terminal capacity; it does not prove current loading or operating utilization. Retired 2026-10-15: no GEM download access; GEM wiki content is CC BY-NC-SA and its static status lags crisis events.

sourceDefinitions.title: GEM Ras Laffan LNG terminal status
sourceDefinitions.note: Asset status is a public registry relationship, not independent proof of current physical flow. Retired 2026-10-15: no GEM download access; GEM wiki content is CC BY-NC-SA and its static status lags crisis events.

sourceDefinitions.title: QatarEnergy LNG Ras Laffan train capacity
sourceDefinitions.note: Reviewed local snapshot of the operator's published per-train nameplate capacities (sum 77.5 MTPA). Refresh annually or when a North Field expansion train starts up. Nameplate capacity does not prove current output.

sourceDefinitions.title: Reviewed Ras Laffan operating status
sourceDefinitions.note: Operating status comes from dated reviewed reporting (force majeure, outages, restarts), not a static asset registry. Update with the same review as qatar-output-status.

sourceDefinitions.title: UN/LOCODE Ras Laffan port identity
sourceDefinitions.note: Local identity snapshot imported from the user-provided artifacts.zip UN/LOCODE CSV. It supplies the stable port identifier only; archive timestamp is retained as the snapshot date, not the row last-change code. It does not establish throughput or cargo movement.

sourceDefinitions.title: PortWatch Hormuz route pressure
sourceDefinitions.note: Disabled: the configured PortWatch Daily_Chokepoints_Data source supplies observed vessel counts, not a route-pressure index. No derived score is promoted from this source.
